text:
phil (PM): Quick thread  We need a repeatable incentive + selection rubric for the next DP wave. Goal: 8 partners, mix of SMB / mid-market, at least 2 regulated-industry customers. Looking for what counts as a 'win' and hard launch gates. Thoughts?

ana (User Research): Keep incentives simple: 3 types only  credits, professional services hours, and co-marketing. Too many options dilutes conversion. Also recommend asking for a primary hypothesis per partner (what they'll validate).

elaine (CS): From ops POV, migration assistance is the #1 motivator for customers with heavy infra. Offer 10 hours of onboarding help as standard for accepted partners. Also we should require a named technical contact and a weekly 30-min sync commitment.

tom (Sales): Sales wants a clear path to convert pilot into paid contract. Suggest a one-time pilot discount (40% off first 3 months) + option to pre-commit to Dedicated capacity at a preferential rate if success metrics met. Need to define the conversion trigger.

phil (PM): Proposal for conversion trigger: partner meets 3 of 4 success gates and requests conversion within 30 days of pilot end. The 4 gates: integration, reliability, latency, and business signal. Draft rubric below.
```
Selection / Success Rubric (points):
- Integration & Onboarding (0-4): docs complete, first inference, infra complexity
- Reliability (0-4): uptime during pilot, incident count
- Latency SLO (0-2): 95th <= target
- Business signal (0-6): product usage, retention projection, revenue potential
Accept if >= 10 points. Success = conversion eligibility if >= 12 and no critical incidents.
```

ana (User Research): Add an "Evaluation Artifact" requirement: each partner must provide 10 labeled test prompts + 3 short product scenarios we can replay. That gives us signal for regressions and quality monitoring.

alaa (Legal): For incentives, update the pilot addendum to call out: (1) limited-time credits, (2) PS hours are delivered under SOW-lite, (3) co-marketing requires joint approval. Also need opt-out language for public case studies.

phil (PM): Launch gates (must all be true to schedule public launch with partner):
- Customer onboarding completed and 1 week of steady-state traffic (no P1s)
- Instrumentation events cover integration + quality signals
- Legal signed pilot addendum + co-marketing consent if requested
- CS playbook completed and handoff scheduled

elaine (CS): Also add a rollback clause in the playbook: if >1 P1 in 7 days, pause customer traffic and prioritize fixes. We'll offer hosted fallback while we remediate.

tom (Sales): Who owns conversion ops? We need an intake field for expected ARR and renew probability so AMs can prioritize follow-up.

phil (PM): Intake fields (minimum): company, contact, deployment type, expected ARR (est), hypothesis to validate, required incentives (checklist), weekly sync slot, legal/regulatory flag. We'll use that to score applicants.

dp-bot: Candidate added: "novus-retail" (tags: retail, SMB, interested in credits + co-marketing).

phil (PM): Timeline suggestion: open intake (Mon), screen + score next 5 business days, notify accepts by end of week, onboarding starts 2w after notification. Pilot length 8 weeks core + optional 4-week extension.

ana (User Research): One more ask: schedule a mid-pilot 1:1 with each partner for qualitative feedback (30m). That plus weekly artifact submission should be mandatory.

alaa (Legal): I'll update the pilot addendum template for incentives + opt-out. Aim to drop a draft by Thu.

phil (PM): Owners / next steps:
- phil: intake form + scoring sheet (today)
- ana: evaluation artifact template + mid-pilot 1:1 script (Tue)
- elaine: CS playbook + rollback steps (Wed)
- tom: conversion path doc + pricing trigger (Wed)
- alaa: pilot addendum updates (Thu)
Any objections or additions? If not, I'll post a short call for collaborators and spin up the intake form. :white_check_mark:

elaine (CS): no objections.

tom (Sales): all good. Leave conversion pricing TBD until we see ARR numbers.

phil (PM): Great, posting now.
